text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is selecting a dessert<n>at the lunch
buffet, when...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! In front of you is just<n>what I was
looking for—our legendary<n>Extra Sweet Banana
Cake!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Or... maybe not. Looks like they're all<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You can't mean to tell me you've<n>never heard of it!
It's the crème de la<n>crème of the school dessert
world.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Bananas have anti-inflammatory<n>properties, which
means they're<n>great for injuries. I always try to eat
at least one before I start training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course, it also tastes delectable!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The combination of whipped cream<n>and ripe
bananas is simply to die for!<n>As soon as it touches
your tongue,<n>the sensa—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Unfortunately, it seems<n>they're all out. I
suppose I'll just<n>need to find myself another
dessert<n>today.
